compose_gtn_graphs: compose two weighted finite-state transducer graphs using gtn.compose to intersect their languages
forward_score_graph: compute the forward log-sum-exp score of a weighted graph using gtn.forward_score
viterbi_path_graph: find the highest-scoring path through a weighted graph using gtn.viterbi_path
concat_gtn_graphs: concatenate multiple graphs in sequence using gtn.concat to chain their languages
union_gtn_graphs: compute the union of multiple graphs using gtn.union to combine their languages
